description: This file defines utility functions related to timestamp manipulation and formatting within the utils package for the repodiff project. It includes functions to get current timestamp, convert timestamps to date strings, and format timestamps for MySQL compatibility.

methods.name: TimestampSeconds
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as a RepoTimestamp.

methods.name: TimestampToDate
methods.description: Converts a RepoTimestamp to a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: TimestampToDataStudioDatetime
methods.description: Formats a RepoTimestamp into a datetime string suitable for MySQL.
